identity.name: Cold Stone Creamery
identity.location: U.S. corporate chain catalog (no specific storefront; packet locationId is null)
notes: The frozen packet supplies no locationId, address, storefront URL, or local vendor identity. The intended scope is therefore the official U.S. corporate chain catalog, not an invented local restaurant.
The official menu states that individual items vary by store. Corporate-listed seasonal and local-favorite items remain current catalog entries with that availability caveat.

sources.excerpt: Official corporate menu publishes the current Signature Creations, sundaes, pre-packed favorites, party packs, cakes, petite cakes, cupcakes, cookie sandwiches, pies, shakes, and smoothies, and warns that individual items vary by store.
Official Create Your Own page publishes 11 always-available flavors, four seasonal flavors, 31 local-favorite flavors, and 29 mix-ins; the page marks seasonal and local favorites as varying by store.
Official nutrition hub links current ingredient, nutrition, and Food Allergies and Sensitivities documents and directs customers with allergies to the chart.

Current six-page Food Allergies and Sensitivities Reference v.042826, copyright 2026, states that X means the item contains the specified allergen and covers egg, milk, peanuts, sesame, soy, tree nuts, and wheat.
Current corporate ingredient statement for ice cream, sorbet, and frozen dessert formulations, linked from the official nutrition hub.
Official ingredient statement for mix-ins and cones supplies formulation detail and cautions that regional, seasonal, supplier, and store-production variations may occur.
Official FAQ says Cold Stone is not nut-free; manufacturing and on-site preparation may leave peanut/tree-nut traces, and residual gluten or lactose may mix on the frequently cleaned frozen slab.
Live official The Perfect Pair page identifies Devil's Food Cake, Cookies 'n' Peanut Butter Ice Cream made with OREO and REESE'S, frosting, and fudge.
Official-linked corporate ordering portal requires a store selection. Because this packet has no locationId, no local storefront was selected or treated as authoritative for chain scope.
Targeted official-document search found the live v.042826 allergen chart and linked ingredient documents; an older 2020 asset path was identified as superseded rather than current evidence.
Targeted web searches corroborated the corporate domain, current menu pages, nutrition hub, FAQ, live promotional pages, and current allergen PDF.

dispositions.notes: Pairwise mappings normalize source typos, trademark encoding, surface/category prefixes, and product presentation. Current v.042826 direct positives supersede the baseline's older positional extraction.

Supergirl Sprinkles is named only as a nested ingredient in current promotional products, not as a separately offered corporate menu product. The long 'Your health...' row is disclaimer prose incorrectly parsed as an item; its safety content is retained as restaurant-level evidence.

reconciliation.notes: All 12 frozen corporate audit keys are represented exactly once: 10 normalized current matches and two parser artifacts.

findings.summary: The packet has no locationId, and the official order portal requires a store. This result intentionally represents the current U.S. corporate catalog and does not borrow a local storefront.

Cold Stone currently publishes a six-page Food Allergies and Sensitivities chart, reference v.042826. It is the controlling current direct-allergen source; the old 2020 asset-path document is superseded.
Official nut, residual-gluten, and residual-lactose cautions are preserved at their stated chain/preparation scope and are not flattened into item-level may-contain arrays.

The baseline promoted nested/disclaimer text to products and omitted obvious current milk/wheat positives from composite desserts while adding unsupported direct positives to some nuts. Current matrix/ingredient evidence replaces those positional artifacts.

The corporate menu DOM contains a duplicate Cake Batter Confetti label pointing to The Perfect Pair and a duplicate Oh Fudge label pointing to a broken Go With the Float URL. The live named product pages and unique current products were normalized without duplicating either product.

The official catalog says individual items vary by store and explicitly marks seasonal/local-favorite flavors as variable. Complete here means complete corporate-listed scope, not universal storefront availability.

proposedChanges: Replace the 12-row fragmentary baseline with the complete 173-product current corporate union across 15 official menu/Create Your Own surfaces.
Normalize 10 current baseline products, remove two parser artifacts, and use current v.042826 direct-allergen evidence rather than older positional output.
Keep store-varying availability explicit and do not import any location-specific ordering catalog while locationId is null.
Retain official nut/gluten/lactose cross-contact warnings only at their stated restaurant/preparation scope.
